subject: Problem with rbind.fill with list of tables

messages.author: 8078800b7ede70d2
messages.subject: Problem with rbind.fill with list of tables
parts:
I have list of tables like this:

> dput(my.list)
structure(list(A = structure(c(24L, 20L, 6L), .Dim = 3L, .Dimnames =
structure(list(
c("0", "1", "2")), .Names = ""), class = "table"), B = structure(c(32L,
14L, 3L, 1L), .Dim = 4L, .Dimnames = structure(list(c("0", "1",
"2", "3")), .Names = ""), class = "table"), C = structure(c(31L,
17L, 2L), .Dim = 3L, .Dimnames = structure(list(c("0", "1", "2"
)), .Names = ""), class = "table")), .Names = c("A", "B", "C"
))
>

I'm trying to rbind this into a single data.frame, but rbind.fill
produces 10 rows where there should be only three. Is this a bug?

> do.call(rbind.fill, my.list)
0 1 2 3
1 24 20 6 NA
2 24 20 6 NA
3 24 20 6 NA
4 32 14 3 1
5 32 14 3 1
6 32 14 3 1
7 32 14 3 1
8 31 17 2 NA
9 31 17 2 NA
10 31 17 2 NA
>

-J

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Problem with rbind.fill with list of tables
parts:
Hi Johannes,

rbind.fill currently only works with data.frames.

Hadley
